text:
Maya P: Quick proposal: run a 4-week infra DP "micro-pilot" (4 partners) to validate rollout controls and lightweight onboarding. Keep scope minimal.
Noah V: 👍 good for speed. recruiting checklist idea?
Maya P: short list: >=500 req/day, ok to share anonymized traces, agree to 1 canary route, 30m kickoff call.
Samir D: incentive: $1k credit + 1 SE office hour. Low friction.
Rina T: measure p50/p95, fallback success rate, and cost/token. weekly auto eval job to S3.
Maya P: sample eval cmd: `redwood eval run --suite dp-mini --out s3://dp-mini/{{partner}}/w{{week}}`
Noah V: feedback routing: form -> ops-bot -> create GitHub issue with labels `dp/partner` + severity. ops-bot?
ops-bot: will add a zap to create issues from form responses. ETA 48h.
Samir D: timeline: recruit in 2 weeks, pilot start in 3. cap at 4 partners.
Maya P: I'll draft outreach DM and onboarding checklist, post in #product-dp-stash by EOD tomorrow.
